clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar, Rilli Greasygob is the specialist Wenikee Boltbucket seeks. She sends you there with a damaged samophlange, hoping his knowledge of its Venture Company origins can explain the device.

Wenikee Boltbucket examined the samophlange recovered from the Venture Company drilling site in the Barrens. Her extra gauges showed the apparatus nearing collapse. More levers and dials might destroy it, so she stopped and sent the problem to someone with knowledge of its design.

In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Wenikee sends you to Nogg's Machine Shop. Rilli Greasygob works there as an engineer and once learned his trade within the Venture Company. He recognizes the machine at once and marvels that anyone survived exploring the company's contested operations in the Barrens.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Well, that didn't work. I put some extra gauges on the samophlange to measure its structural integrity, and they read the integrity at an all-time low. I could add some more dials and maybe a lever or two to try and fix it, but... I think that might make things even worse.
You should take the samophlange to Rilli Greasygob. He used to work for the Venture Company -- if anyone knows how to fix it, it's Rilli.
You can find him at Nogg's Machine Shop in Orgrimmar, in the Valley of Honor.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Mind your head! I don't want it to get in the way of my work!

clips.title: Completion
paras: What's this? Why, it's a samophlange! Where did you get this thing? Have you been poking around the Venture Company holdings in the Barrens?
You must be very brave, or very stupid.
